ms.report:
cardano.nix MFinal Proof of Achievement

For the final milestone, we have added two new modules: a secure HTTP proxy and a monitoring module. We also improved documentation.
This includes for each module:
- a NixOS module starting the required services
- new options in the `cardano` super-module for frictionless integration the new services
- a NixOS test (executed in CI)
- automatically generated documentation continuously deployed on the website
Secure HTTP proxy and load balancer
This module consists of a helper module to set up the nginx web server with the following functions: 
- HTTPS / TLS secure endpoint
- HTTP proxy
- load balancer
We also provide an integration module `cardano.http` that configures upstreams for cardano services.
- NixOS module source: https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/cardano.nix/blob/47f57549525032753f0aa371bef9a51fc5feed0c/modules/services/http-proxy.nix
https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/cardano.nix/blob/47f57549525032753f0aa371bef9a51fc5feed0c/modules/http.nix
- Service docs: https://mlabs-haskell.github.io/cardano.nix/reference/module-options/services.http-proxy
https://mlabs-haskell.github.io/cardano.nix/reference/module-options/cardano.http
- Test source: https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/cardano.nix/blob/47f57549525032753f0aa371bef9a51fc5feed0c/tests/http.nix
https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/cardano.nix/blob/47f57549525032753f0aa371bef9a51fc5feed0c/tests/load-balancer.nix
- Test executed in CI: 
https://hercules-ci.com/github/mlabs-haskell/cardano.nix/jobs/952/effects/effects.vmTests-http/log
https://hercules-ci.com/github/mlabs-haskell/cardano.nix/jobs/952/effects/effects.vmTests-load-balancer/log
Monitoring module
We created a monitoring module using Prometheus and Grafana, setting up Prometheus exporters and scrapers for all included services, as well as some Grafana dashboards.
- NixOS module source: https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/cardano.nix/blob/47f57549525032753f0aa371bef9a51fc5feed0c/modules/monitoring.nix
